properties.description: Built 2026-10-17 in reflow2-core's reasoning, report and detect modules (PR #763). On a design holding Inferences, loop_status carries `reasoning` (counts, and ids up to 20 each), said in `next` and never counted against `clean`; detect_gaps raises one aggregate low-severity `unconfirmed_reasoning` gap. `taken_as_given: true` (add_constraint, add_requirement) marks a stated foundation: not an uncited premise, listed in reasoning_report's stated_foundations; a Requirement taken as given holds. A design with no Inference reads byte for byte as before. Phase 2 (2026-10-17, branch feat/a-proof-says-what-it-assumes-and-asks) built the deferral: Constraint.direction has no schema default, add_constraint writes `maximum` only beside a `limit`, so a definition or axiom carries no budget words and every stored constraint keeps what it has. loop_status.reasoning also counts what is not as stated (undischarged assumptions, generalizations over a fixed variable, stated independence not borne out).
properties.name: loop_status and detect_gaps count a reasoning's unconfirmed steps, uncited premises and claims shown but not proven, and a definition or axiom can be taken as given
